gloss_en: the growth/flourishing of faith (גְּדֵלָה הָאֱמוּנָה, 'faith grows') — emunah increasing and being nurtured, in Likutey Moharan II:5 specifically as the result of the waters of counsels (etzot), per Isaiah 25:1 'counsels from afar, faithful and true'; from גָּדַל 'to grow', not any homograph of גדלה (e.g. גְּדֻלָּה 'greatness')
